desc: Derive the exact ranges \([4^k,4^{k+1}-1]\) on which every number requires \(k+1\) reductions.
Design a prefix-sum function \(F(n)=\sum_{x=1}^{n} f(x)\) by iterating over powers of 4, allowing each query total to be computed as \(F(r)-F(l-1)\).
Confirm the lower bound \(\lceil S/2\rceil\) and prove it is achievable by pairing reductions across elements, including cases with an odd number of remaining reductions.
Implement `Solution.minOperations` using integer arithmetic, 64-bit-safe totals, and no iteration over individual values.
Test the implementation on both examples and boundary cases such as ranges crossing powers of 4 and values near \(10^9\).
